description: Internal alterations and refurbishment comprising strip-out and replacement of kitchen in existing layout, including extension of 1980s partition reducing kitchen doorway from double to single door; refitting of principal en-suite and bathroom within existing rooms; extension of hallway cylinder cupboard, with new double doors in place of single door, to house replacement hot water cylinder and condensing unit of new, internal water-cooled comfort cooling system serving two new wall-mounted units in reception room and principal bedroom; like-for-like replacement of boiler in existing position; new engineered oak flooring laid as floating floor on acoustic underlay over floors; internal shutters to windows of principal bedroom and Bedroom 2; new and replacement recessed downlights, additional sockets and lighting points, upgraded bathroom extract fans ducted to terminals; redecoration throughout.
